verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a tax-compliance SaaS/API platform, not an AI agent; the only MCP-related evidence shows Kintsugi providing its own MCP server for AI assistants to access its API docs (the server role), not Kintsugi acting as a client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools. This client-consumption axis is a category mismatch for a compliance API product.
